description: Show the transitive dependency path(s) between two modules — how module A reaches module B through the import graph. Use to answer 'how does X depend on Y?', trace coupling, or generate a dependency diagram. format='mermaid'/'dot' emits a diagram; default text lists the hops.

all.description: Show all simple paths instead of just the shortest (default: false)

format.description: Output format: "text" (default, hop listing), "json", "mermaid" or "dot" (dependency diagram)

from.description: Source module — the one whose dependencies are followed (name or path, e.g. "auth", "apps/api")

maxDepth.description: Cap on path length in hops (default: 20, max: 50)

maxPaths.description: Cap on number of paths returned (default: 50, max: 200)

viaKind.description: Restrict traversal to a dependency kind (default: "all")

name: module_route
